description: This file defines drag-and-drop configuration for dashboard components, including interfaces for props, drag items, drop results, and configuration objects for react-dnd integration.

classes.name: DragDroppableComponent
classes.description: Represents a draggable component with mounted state, ref, props, and setState method.

methods.name: canDrag
methods.description: Determines if dragging is allowed based on disableDragDrop prop.

methods.name: beginDrag
methods.description: Creates a DragItem object representing the component being dragged.

methods.name: dragStateToProps
methods.description: Maps drag source state to component props for react-dnd.

methods.name: canDrop
methods.description: Checks if dropping is allowed based on disableDragDrop prop.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Handles hover event during drag, invoking handleHover.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Handles drop event, invoking handleDrop if conditions are met.

methods.name: dropStateToProps
methods.description: Maps drop target state to component props for react-dnd.
